query:
insert into FileHashes (
                    latest_collection,
                    hash,
                    content
                )
                values (
                    $1,
                    $2,
                    $3
                )
                on conflict (
                    hash
                ) do update
                set
                    latest_collection = excluded.latest_collection,
                    -- we take the one that is not null
                    content = coalesce(excluded.content, FileHashes.content)
